title: Federated learning system and method

pse.problem: The current federated learning systems suffer from potential data leakage risks due to direct sharing of data between organizations. There's also the issue of decreased efficiency as the number of participating devices increases in some cryptography-based solutions.
pse.solution_function: The invention presents a secure federated learning system that operates with multiple data transmitting devices and a central server. The system employs homomorphic encryption to allow each device to perform calculations on encrypted data, ensuring privacy. The central server aggregates the encrypted results, decodes them, and updates the learning model.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of data transmitting devices, a central server with homomorphic encryption capabilities, and a learning model.
pse.solution_implementation: Each device processes its local data using homomorphically encrypted calculations. The encrypted results are sent to the central server which aggregates them, decodes the aggregate, and updates the learning model. This process is repeated iteratively until convergence.
pse.effect: The solution ensures privacy as no raw data is shared between devices or the server. It also maintains efficiency as the calculation and communication costs are independent of the number of participating devices.
